hid.source: interface 5, interrupt EP4 IN 64 B and EP5 OUT 128 B, no report ids: seen from Linux on 2026-10-08 (docs/vision.md), as LOU-RB3 and VZ-F describe it (docs/research/flx10-displays.md); experimental: wake, handshake and keepalive tried on this repo's unit (each step's observed), the rest untried

steps.name: wake
steps.source: the 7 vendor control transfers rekordbox sends on ep0 at connect, byte for byte (LOU-RB3; VZ-F "Vendor unlock"; docs/research/flx10-displays.md "Gating and setup"), kernel drivers still bound; sent once, as the device can wedge under repeated ep0 traffic (LOU-JOG)
steps.observed: 2026-10-08: sent through Linux usbfs, then handshake and keepalive, it took both jog screens out of "no audio driver" to spinners, then 120.00, -100% and 00:00, which handshake and keepalive alone did not (docs/research/flx10-observed.md)

steps.name: handshake
steps.source: the distinct SysEx rekordbox sends at connect, in first-seen order (LOU-RB3 table), bytes as LOU-INIT holds them (Loui1979 HID/rb_init_sequence.json, Unlicense); LOU-JOG: with the keepalive it took the screens out of the rekordbox splash, after the ep0 vendor transfers, which no browser can send over WebHID. The capture interleaves plain MIDI LED and display messages, left out here
steps.observed: 2026-10-08: with keepalive, it left the screens on "no audio driver" alone, and woke them after wake (docs/research/flx10-observed.md)

steps.name: keepalive
steps.source: rekordbox sends it about every 200 ms all session (VZ-F; LOU-RB3: 281 times in one capture; docs/research/flx10-sysex.md)

virtual.source: no unit states these: chosen for a unit with no hardware. Every knob, TEMPO and the crossfader rest at their centres and the four channel faders at the top, so a deck is heard as it plays; each selector rests at its first position here (crossfader assign THRU, input PC A, MIC OFF, the first Beat FX on its dial, Beat FX channel MASTER, decks 1 and 2 in control), LINE off. Each selector's positions are the ones the list files under one switch (MML p.2 M11, p.3 M17, M18, F13, F14); DECK SELECT moving its side's in-control between its two decks is read from MAN p.20 and MML p.2 D5, unobserved. The order a unit sends a selector's two messages in is unobserved: the position left first, here.

controls.observed: 2026-10-10, owner: one lap summed 1,081 ticks over 295 messages, each +3, +4 or +5, never +1 or +2, and a very slow quarter turn sent nothing: the firmware reports the side only above a speed threshold, in steps of 3 or more, so a lap's sum depends on speed and no revolution is stated. By design, per Algoriddim staff (2025-09-25): the firmware ignores rim movement below a certain speed, built with Serato's behaviour in mind, so subwoofers rattling the controller do not read as movement (https://community.algoriddim.com/t/flx10-jogwheel-fine-adjustment-not-possible-in-pause-mode/38423; that thread's user ran firmware 1.14, this unit reports 1.13). Open question, not a per-deck fact: on 2026-10-08 deck 1's side sent +1 and +2 steps (+1..+9), so the threshold may depend on controller state rather than deck; decks 1, 3 and 4 not measured since (crates/dj-controller-core/fixtures/ddj-flx10-jog-laps-2026-10-10.hex; docs/research/flx10-observed-jog.md)
